blocks.text: Airplane-mode test: a device offline for a long stretch, a pile of inspections, then check every one lands in order. Tybalt's bar is a week. Owner TBD.
Balthasar's six-device run, including the old Android 11 tablet.
Friday demo: make an inspection offline, reconnect, watch it sync. That's the end-to-end test Ducal actually sees.
Duplicate sends: send the same event twice on purpose and check the receiver keeps one.
Capulet sees inspections: the full record, findings and photos included.
Montague sees the routing envelope: who sent an event, where it's going, when it was sent. Not the findings.
Ducal sees only its own sites. Nothing from Montague's routing data.
Same line I gave Paris this morning: Ducal sees only what Ducal sends.
